html:
Session length: 1h30
Temperature: -22 celsius
Object observed: Orion Nebula

Description: During the previous session, I took a few piggyback photos with the EOS Xti. This time, I wanted to try a photo of the nebula at the "prime focus" of the LX90. After an "altaz" polar alignment, I used Sirius to focus. I had a terrible time getting a decent focus at that temperature. In fact, the photo shown is quite blurry and the stars are triangular. After a few minutes, I gave up on getting a better result and shot a series of 60 sec photos at ISO 800. Well, it's far from perfect, but it's a good start. I didn't spend much time on the colors.
